ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the oath by the sun in Surah Ash-Shams?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this oath highlights the sun's role as a divine sign (ayah) of God's creative power and order, reinforcing the moral accountability of the human soul (nafs). The emphasis on 'its brightness' (duha) underscores the clarity of divine guidance, linking the physical light of the sun to the spiritual illumination required for self-purification (tazkiyah). This rhetorical device serves to awaken the believer's conscience regarding their potential for both success and ruin.
